axis_assignment.rationale: Across the 56-row ledger, MASS (IR-88-52/53), CONCENTRATION (IR-88-52), and SNAP (IR-88-47/51) are closed as slot axes, RELIEF has 9 negative HOLD arms, SPACING is sub-threshold (+0.00074 max) and lowest-priority, and TRACKB is Phase 2 only. Every active candidate in SLOT_PLAN.md (PRUNEp3px, PRUNEp3space35, PRUNEp4space35) sits on AXIS=PRUNE with parent R0, yet PRUNEp3space35 (49fff49b, +0.0050 SGMC vs R0) carries three unresolved confounders logged in IR-88-45 and IR-88-47: (1) an off-by-one collar inequality (d_cat <= 3.0 px instead of < 3.0 px, deleting 560 R0 dots at exact d_cat == 3.0 px where the 300 m kernel weight k(3.0) == 0.0 and Brief section 4.4 >= 3 px is already satisfied); (2) refill ranking by the four-line field w (blind SGMC AUC 0.4724, IR-88-38) never tested against a score-blind farthest-point control (the IR-88-45 queued falsifier); and (3) widening the refill support with leaderboard-selected sibling rasters H19-4 and H16-1 rather than purely organizer-provided 19-band structural crests.

lt3space35.hypothesis: Under the official R = 300 m (3.0 px) triangular kernel k(d) = max(0, 1 - d/3.0), R0's 560 dots at exact d_cat == 3.0000 px (d^2 = 9) already carry zero kernel overlap with existing_faults.tif and already satisfy Brief section 4.4's literal >= 3 px clearance, sampling real 300 m fault splays and step-over relays around mapped traces. Purging only the 1,611 dots strictly inside 3.0 px (d^2 in {5, 8}) removes the GeoDAWN 400 m flight-line halo while preserving those 560 splay dots and refilling 1,611 >= 3.5 px-spaced ridge dots.
lt3space35.non_fault_mimic: Erosional alluvial-fan-head scarplets and 400 m aeromagnetic flight-line leveling ripples paralleling mapped range-front faults at 300 m offset (d_cat == 3.0 px) without brittle fault slip.
lt3space35.falsifier: Live receipt <= R0 - 0.01 falsifies net benefit; monotonic ordering R0 < lt3space35 < p3space35 < p4space35 falsifies superiority of R0's 560 d_cat == 3.0 px rim dots over spaced ancestor ridge refills and proves the gain scales with spaced-refill replacement dose.

p3space35fp.single_factor_vs_p3space35: score-blind greedy farthest-point Euclidean distance ranking (deterministic row-major tie-break, zero w-field, zero bands, zero RNG) instead of exact-marginal w-field DTI ranking
p3space35fp.refill_pool: H19-5 union H19-4 union H16-1 (157,085 px) at d_catalogue > 3.0 px (identical 6,632 cage-free pool to p3space35)
p3space35fp.ranking_rule: greedy farthest-point completion: iteratively pick the available pool pixel maximizing min Euclidean distance to all surviving and already-picked dots (row-major tie-break); zero physical bands, zero w-field
p3space35fp.hypothesis: Because the four-line field w weights GDR geothermometry, radiometric K/Th, and raw potential-field gradients that cluster around already-catalogued geothermal districts (blind SGMC AUC 0.4724 < 0.50, IR-88-38; hot-prior blocks 31.8 px from unmapped faults, IR-88-52), w biases p3space35 toward tight 3.5-4.0 px clusters near mapped hubs. Score-blind farthest-point completion places all 2,171 refills at the centers of the largest uncovered gaps (>= 5.66 px min NN, 8.0 px median > 2R = 6.0 px) along un-emitted ridge strands, eliminating kernel redundancy and directly testing IR-88-45's ranking confounder.
p3space35fp.non_fault_mimic: Distal H19-4/H16-1 ridge segments tracing unfaulted Tertiary volcanic flow margins, pluton-roof contacts, or Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville shorelines that attract farthest-point picks solely through geometric isolation.
p3space35fp.falsifier: If p3space35 beats p3space35fp by >= 0.01 live (or by > 0.002 on the blind off-catalogue SGMC control at identical collar, count, pool, and 3.5 px lock), the anti-w hypothesis is falsified and w carries genuine off-catalogue ranking lift; if p3space35fp >= p3space35, w-ranking is retired on spaced ridge pools.

p3space35prov.hypothesis: Piedmont normal-fault scarps form inflection lines of topographic slope (Hessian ridges of |grad(det_elev_slope)|, avoiding constant-slope canyon walls) co-registered with Hessian crests of TMI/isostatic-gravity horizontal gradients and basement-depth steps. Matching the exact 157,085-px support area of p3space35 using only provided competition bands tests IR-88-45: whether p3space35's +0.0050 blind margin required leaderboard-selected H19-4/H16-1 sibling supports or survives on purely organizer-provided structural breaklines.
p3space35prov.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted coalescing alluvial-fan bajada toe inflections, incised fluvial terrace risers (|grad(det_elev_slope)|), and shallow Tertiary volcanic dike or paleochannel edges lacking brittle fault permeability.

decision_rules: No PROXY or MODEL number is a score; all predictions above remain frozen verbatim in the ledger, mechanism cards, and receipts regardless of post-build proxy outcomes.

Ordering on the report-only blind SGMC control is diagnostic only: if p3space35fp >= p3space35 - 0.0005, w-ranking adds zero blind value and p3space35fp is preferred on parsimony (zero external features in refill ranking); if p3space35prov >= p3space35 - 0.001, leaderboard-tuned ancestor provenance (IR-88-45) is not required for the spaced-refill effect.
Every live change with |delta| < 0.01 on public chunks is no evidence.
